device_name: iFuse Bedrock Granite Sacroiliac Fusion System
description: The iFuse Bedrock Granite is a 3D printed titanium microporous lattice outer structure that mimics cancellous bone for increased bony ingrowth. The Screw is intended for sacro-iliac and pelvic fixation as well as increased fusion at the sacrum (S1).
features: 3D printed "FuSIon Surface" that mimics cancellous bone for increased fusion
Intelliharvest fenestrations allow for self-harvesting of autograft bone on implantation.
40 degrees of favored angle sway for optimal rod capture.
For use in the S1, S2AI, Iliac bolts
Available with open or closed tulip head
